test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 1 Feb 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Sita can clean a hotel in 20 days. Rita can clean the same hotel in 30 days. How many days will they take to clean the hotel together?
solution:
**Given:**

Sita can clean a hotel in 20 days.

Rita can clean the same hotel in 30 days.

**Concept used:**

Rate of work (Efficiency) =** (Total work)/(Time taken)**

**Calculation:**

According to the question

Total work = L.C.M. of (20, 30) = 60
